items.t: Why Blink Charging (BLNK) stock is trading up today
items.sum: Shares of EV charging infrastructure provider Blink Charging (NASDAQ:BLNK) jumped 25.7% in the afternoon session after the company reported its third-quarter 2026 financial results, achieving its first positive quarterly adjusted EBITDA ahead of target.

items.t: BLNK Q3 2026 deep dive: profitability milestone but revenue headwinds prompt strategic shift
items.sum: EV charging infrastructure provider Blink Charging (NASDAQ:BLNK) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales falling 32% year on year to $18.4 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $79.5 million at the midpoint came in 12.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.
